papers.title_en: High-Rank Encoding Can Improve Approximate Quantum Error Correction
papers.evidence: 研究量子纠错编码器秩对近似恢复性能的影响，属于量子纠错编码理论核心议题
papers.tldr: 传统量子码构造通常要求将纯逻辑态编码为纯码态，这种限制可能导致纠错性能下降。本文研究高秩编码的内在随机性，揭示其能显著提高最优纠缠保真度；他们量化了秩为一编码器的损失，证明在联合优化后接近完美恢复时损失至多为二次。还给出了一个显式噪声族，其中高秩编码器可任意接近完美恢复，而每个最优编码器都会将纯输入映射为混合码态。此种优化带来的优势在小噪声扰动下仍然存在，为近似量子纠错设计开辟了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Conventional quantum-code constructions encode pure logical states as pure code states, but this restriction can sacrifice performance. We show that intrinsic encoding randomness can improve optimal entanglement fidelity. We bound the loss from imposing a rank-one encoder and prove it is at most quadratic near perfect recovery after joint optimization. The optimized advantage survives small noise perturbations. An explicit noise family requires higher-rank encoders arbitrarily close to perfect recovery, with every optimal encoder mapping pure inputs to mixed code states.

papers.title_en: Constraint-Preserving Genetic Algorithms for Embedding Linear Codes into Self-Orthogonal Codes
papers.authors: Haeun Lim, Junmin An, Jon-Lark Kim
papers.evidence: 自正交线性码是量子稳定子码/CSS码构造的重要基础，嵌入算法直接服务于码搜索
papers.tldr: 针对构造二元最优自正交码的问题，提出基于最短自正交嵌入的遗传算法框架。利用最小距离与最小重量码字数设计适应度，并构造约束保留的交叉变异操作，保证染色体有效且传播高适应度特征。实验获得66个达到上界的新最优码及135个最佳最小距离码。该框架为自正交码搜索提供了高效且可验证的启发式方案。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we aim to construct binary optimal self-orthogonal codes using shortest self-orthogonal embedding methods. For this purpose, we design a heuristic framework based on a genetic algorithm. We explore the search space of shortest self-orthogonal embeddings using a fitness function based on the minimum distance and the number of minimum-weight codewords. We construct \emph{constraint-preserving} crossover and mutation operations so that every chromosome yields a valid self-orthogonal embedding, while high-fitness structural features, such as favorable subsequences of orthogonal generators, are propagated across generations. We also analyze the time and storage complexity of the algorithm, and validate our design through an ablation study on guided crossover and a comparison with random search under an equal time budget. Using this method, we obtain $66$ new binary optimal self-orthogonal codes that meet the upper bound, together with $135$ further self-orthogonal codes attaining the best minimum distance found so far.
